name: sdd-hybrid
description: Spec-driven development workflow for Web, Mobile Apps (iOS & Android via Expo, Flutter, Kotlin), and 2D/2.5D Games: Brainstorm -> Constitution -> Plan (with 22 design templates, 19 shared modules, or Game Asset Requirements) -> Build (with auto asset/video generation, multi-layer parallax segmentation, texture tiling, background removal, and UI integration) -> Review -> Security (OWASP Web & Mobile Top 10).
